{{nihongo|'''Inashironimasu Shrine'''|稲代坐神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

'''Inashiro-ni-masu Shrine''' (いなしろにますじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}{{ill|Kashihara, Nara|ar|كاشيهارا (نارا)|azb|کاشیهارا، نارا|ca|Kashihara|ce|Касихара|ceb|Kashihara-shi (lungsod sa Hapon)|cs|Kašihara|de|Kashihara|eo|Kaŝihara|es|Kashihara (Nara)|eu|Kashihara (Nara)|fa|کاشیهارا، نارا|fi|Kashihara|fr|Kashihara|gl|Kashihara|hy|Կաշիհարա|id|Kashihara, Nara|it|Kashihara|ja|橿原市|ko|가시하라시|ms|Kashihara, Nara|mzn|کاشیهارا، نارا|nl|Kashihara|no|Kashihara|pl|Kashihara|pt|Kashihara|ro|Kashihara|ru|Касихара|sh|Kashihara|simple|Kashihara, Nara|sr|Кашихара|sv|Kashihara|tg|Кашиҳара|th|คาชิฮาระ|tl|Kashihara, Nara|tr|Kashihara|tt|Касихара|uk|Касіхара|ur|کاشی ہارا، نارا|vi|Kashihara, Nara|war|Kashihara, Nara|zh|橿原市|zh_classical|橿原市|zh_min_nan|Kasihara-chhī|zh_yue|橿原|qid=Q496319}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinai Taisha|ja|式内大社|simple|Shikinai Taisha|qid=Q134917288}}, and its former {{ill|Shakaku|Q10444029|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}.

=== History ===
=== Overview ===
The date of founding is unknown, but in the *Shinshō Chokaku Fushō* it is recorded in the first year of {{ill|Daidō|de|Daidō (Ära)|es|Daidō|fa|دایدو (دوره)|fr|Ère Daidō|ia|Daido|id|Daidō|ja|大同 (日本)|ko|다이도 (일본)|ru|Дайдо (нэнго)|simple|Daidō|sr|Даидо|th|ไดโด|tr|Daidō|uk|Дайдо|zh|大同 (日本)|zh_yue|大同 (日本)|qid=Q1373191|lt=Daidō}} ({{ill|806|ab|806|af|806|als|806|am|806 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|806|ar|806|ary|806|ast|806|az|806|azb|۸۰۶ (میلادی)|bar|806|bcl|806|be|806|be_x_old|806|bg|806|bn|৮০৬|bpy|মারি ৮০৬|br|806|bs|806.|ca|806|cdo|806 nièng|ceb|806|ckb|٨٠٦|crh|806|cs|806|csb|806|cv|806|cy|806|da|806|de|806|el|806|eml|806|eo|806|es|806|et|806|eu|806|fa|۸۰۶ (میلادی)|fi|806|fo|806|fr|806|frr|806|fy|806|ga|806|gan|806年|gd|806|gl|806|he|806|hi|806|hr|806.|ht|806 (almanak jilyen)|hu|806|hy|806|id|806|ilo|806|io|806|is|806|it|806|ja|806年|jv|806|ka|806|kaa|806|kk|806 жыл|ko|806년|la|806|lb|806|lij|806|lmo|806|lt|806 m.|lv|806. gads|map_bms|806|mdf|806|mg|806|mhr|806|mk|806|mr|इ.स. ८०६|mrj|806 и|ms|806|mzn|۸۰۶|nah|806|nap|806|nds|806|new|सन् ८०६|nl|806|nn|806|no|806|nrm|806|nso|806|oc|806|or|୮୦୬|os|806-æм аз|pl|806|pt|806|qu|806|ro|806|ru|806 год|rue|806|sa|८०६|scn|806|sd|806ع|se|806|sh|806.|shn|806|si|806|sk|806|sl|806|smn|806|sq|806|sr|806|su|806|sv|806|sw|806|tg|Соли 806|th|พ.ศ. 1349|tk|806|tl|806|tly|806|tr|806|tt|806 ел|uk|806|ur|806ء|uz|806|vec|806|vi|806|vls|806|war|806|wuu|806年|xmf|806|zh|806年|zh_min_nan|806 nî|zh_yue|806年|qid=Q30021}}) as “Inashiro Shrine, one household,” indicating that it was already enshrined more than 1,180 years ago. In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}, it is listed as a major shrine and is noted as receiving offerings at the monthly and Niiname festivals ({{ill|Hōhei|Q11445508|qid=Q11445508}}).
